face.name: 艾比西安
face.text: 战吼：在本局对战中，你的龙拥有突袭。（当本牌在你手中时，使用一张龙牌即可将本牌变为12/12的龙！）
face.flavorText: 我叫什么？我叫艾，呃，嘿嘿，叫……嘿叫！对，我叫黑角。

face.name: Ebyssian
face.text: Battlecry: Your Dragons have Rush this game. (While in hand, play a Dragon to become a 12/12 Dragon!)
face.flavorText: What's my name? Oh, uh, it's... Eb...onhorn. Yeah. Ebonhorn.

face.name: 艾比西安
face.text: 战吼：在本局对战中，你的龙拥有 突袭。

face.name: Ebyssian
face.text: Battlecry: Your Dragons have Rush this game.

face.name: 淹没的地图
face.text: 发现一张鱼人牌，如果你在本回合中使用该牌，再从其余选项中选择一张。
face.flavorText: 是的，这条路线直通拉特维亚。你能在水下屏气多久呢？

face.name: Submerged Map
face.text: Discover a Murloc. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
face.flavorText: Sure, it leads straight to Latorvia. How long can you hold your breath?

face.name: 虫巢地图
face.text: 发现一张邪能法术牌，如果你在本回合中使用该牌，再从其余选项中选择一张。
face.flavorText: 地图本身完美，只是这个地点你永远永远永远都不会去。

face.name: Hive Map
face.text: Discover a Fel spell. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
face.flavorText: The perfect map of where to never ever ever ever ever go.

face.name: 异教地图
face.text: 从你的牌库中发现一张牌，如果你在本回合中使用该牌，再从其余选项中选择一张。
face.flavorText: 究竟是隐甲龟的侦查技艺确实精湛？还是说诅咒教派离谱过于离谱，把他们的机密地图到处乱丢？

face.name: Cultist Map
face.text: Discover a card from your deck. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
face.flavorText: Are the Shrouded Shells actually great trackers, or are the Cult of the Damned just REALLY bad about leaving secret maps lying around?

face.name: 泰坦考据学家欧斯克
face.text: 在你的手牌中时， 随机获得一项泰坦技能。该技能每回合都会改变。
face.flavorText: 看看这张泰坦考据图吧。

face.name: Titanographer Osk
face.text: Gains a random Titan ability in your hand that changes each turn.

face.name: 兵主
face.text: 泰坦 在本随从使用一个技能后，发现一张对应符文的牌。
face.flavorText: 既然存在泰坦万神殿，也就有死亡万神殿，其中包括暗影界各位强大的统治者。

face.name: The Primus
face.text: Titan After this uses an ability, Discover a card with that Rune.
face.flavorText: As there is a Pantheon of titans, so is there also a Pantheon of Death, comprised of powerful rulers in the Shadowlands.

face.name: 翠绿之星阿古斯
face.text: 泰坦 本随从左边的随从均拥有突袭，本随从右边的随从均拥有吸血。
face.flavorText: 阿古斯曾是一位高傲的泰坦，命运却引他走向了黑暗的结局。萨格拉斯与麾下的恶魔腐蚀了阿古斯，将他的力量据为己有，星球也因此而破碎。

face.name: Argus, the Emerald Star
face.text: Titan Minions to the left of this have Rush, and ones to the right have Lifesteal.
face.flavorText: Once a proud titan, Argus was fated to meet a darker end. Sargeras and his demons would later corrupt and shatter Argus to use his power for themselves.

face.name: 灭世泰坦萨格拉斯
face.text: 泰坦 战吼：打开一道传送门，每回合召唤两个3/2的小鬼。
face.flavorText: 他曾是万神殿的护卫者，在执行任务时心志幻灭，于是组建了燃烧军团，旨在扫平宇宙间的一切生命。

face.name: Sargeras, the Destroyer
face.text: Titan Battlecry: Open a portal that summons two 3/2 Imps each turn.
face.flavorText: Formerly the Defender of the Pantheon, he became disillusioned by his mission and formed the Burning Legion to destroy all life within the universe.

token_mapping_limit: TLC forms do not expose a direct child edge to the token. Mappings infer copied Titan abilities from complete matching summon bodies plus primary Titan child links and exact token faces; this is an explicit internal identity policy pending CN calibration, not a claimed direct official TLC-to-token link.

policies.maps: DiscoverForPlayFollowup binds original offers and physical hand residence; completed own same-turn card_played consumes once; expiry/leave-reentry/overflow follow native lifecycle. Murloc/all collectible pool and Fel SPELL collectible pool both current hero class plus Neutral, explicit internal M6 policy. No implemented-only crop.
policies.deck_map: ChooseFromZone owner=player DECK operation=take, explicit distinct physical entity and sample_size3. Retains original physical offer references, no card copy, requery or reroll for reward. Exact physical duplicate weighting/distinct offers and take-vs-draw policy remain M6 pending.
policies.abyssian: Original card_committed event uses existing entry_native dragon condition over submitted Dragon/all. Held same entity transforms to CATA_553t. Both battlecries install one public persistent Dragon Rush PlayerEffectSpec; current controller/tribe/all and native attack quota evaluated by ordinary aura layer. Duplicate contributions union; source departure/silence does not revoke player instances.
policies.fixed_summons: Explicit mappings only: TLC_452t3 -> TTN_737t2 twice; TLC_452t6 -> TTN_862t4 four times; TLC_452t28 -> TTN_960t5 twice. Each original request has one named material and original SummonCause; ordinary quantities, sequential delivery, board capacity, death/Reborn apply. No Titan parent/portal/hand-changing Osk behavior.
